evaluate.evaluate(make_env, agents, *, team, player, train_seed, n_games, record) has 7 arguments, over CR-20's ruff PLR0913 max-args = 5, so the frozen signature fails the gate; fix: Revise the contract (e.g. group team/n_games/record into one evaluation-options type) or a build-setup exception for PLR0913 on this function

agents.DQNAgent.__init__(obs_shape, n_actions, params, exploration, *, seed, use_memory, use_target) has 7 parameters; ruff PLR0913 (CR-20, max-args = 5) fails the gate on the frozen signature, as evaluate.evaluate did before AD-17. Suggested shape: fold the ABL-01/ABL-02 switches into one frozen value (e.g. a DQNSwitches(use_memory=True, use_target=True) dataclass, or take the RunSettings ablation literal), keeping obs_shape, n_actions, params, exploration, *, seed. I checked every other M1 contract signature: all are within max-args 5 and max-positional 4. Separate, for build-setup rather than the contract: typos (check.sh fast and full, not gate) flags the frozen core.AgentParams field gae_lambda ('gae'), so check.sh full will fail until [tool.typos] allows that identifier.

compare.run_claims takes charts: Sequence[viz.Chart] (EVAL-11, 2026-10-17 contract row), but the architecture and CONSTRAINTS boundaries say compare -> evaluate only, and pyproject's import-linter layers put compare and viz as independent siblings ('(rllab.train) | (rllab.reference) | (rllab.compare) | (rllab.viz) | (rllab.baselines)'). Writing the frozen signature needs 'from rllab.viz import Chart' in rllab.compare, which fails lint-imports (CR-24) even under TYPE_CHECKING, so the interface cannot pass the gate as specified. Options: (a) let compare depend on viz (architecture + build-setup: layers and the 'compare -> evaluate' rule), (b) move viz.Chart to a lower component (e.g. runs or evaluate) so both can import it, or (c) have run_claims take chart paths (charts: Sequence[Path]). Related nits found while reading: envs.Snake.reset_to returns a bare np.ndarray and dict[str, int] while core.Env.reset returns team-keyed dict obs and dict[str, float] (AD-13); CONSTRAINTS says viz -> runs while pyproject names viz -> runs, evaluate (plot_curves takes evaluate.ScoreSet); and PL-04's load_report_spec/score_players/open_curve_runs pass a 'targets' value (players, baselines, ladder and ablation groups, crossplay charts) and a curves value (.ladder, .ablations) that have no contract type, though they cross tasks M1-T09 and M1-T10.

The gate check itself is wrong, not an intent test (no kind fits better): dt claim writes .claude/.check_pkg = 'rllab' (the plan's package), so the Stop hook and dt land run 'scripts/check.sh gate --pkg rllab', but check.sh's pkg_scope lists only the components (core, envs, ..., lab), so it exits 64 'unknown package rllab' before running any check. M1-T01's previous attempt (solo-4) was rejected for exactly this, rc 64, and this attempt and every later task will be too. Fix through build-setup: add an 'rllab)' case to pkg_scope in scripts/check.sh (all components, or treat the single package as no --pkg), or have dt claim leave .check_pkg empty for a single-package project. Then re-dispatch M1-T01.

Not a package: a build-setup fix. dt claim writes .claude/.check_pkg=rllab (the task's package), so the Stop gate and dt land run 'scripts/check.sh gate --pkg rllab', but pkg_scope in scripts/check.sh only knows the components (core, envs, ..., lab), not 'rllab', so it exits 64 before running any check. No code change can pass it (this is why M1-T01.solo-6 was rejected with rc 64). Fix through build-setup Revise: add an 'rllab' case to pkg_scope (all components) or have dt claim write no --pkg for a single-package project; then re-run M1-T01.

TC-12 and TC-13 need values the agents.TabularAgent interface does not expose. TC-12 expects Q(cell 8, right)=0.1 and Q(cell 7, right)=0.009 within 1e-12, but the frozen signature is only __init__ plus Agent.act/learn/save/load: no way to read a table value, and the NPZ checkpoint layout (keys) is unspecified. TC-13 expects the exploration rate 1.0/0.525/0.05/0.05 at steps 0/25000/50000/80000 within 1e-9, but no symbol returns the rate for a step, and it is not stated whether a step counts act or learn calls. A statistical check through act cannot reach 1e-9. Proposed: add to agents.TabularAgent a 'value(obs: np.ndarray, action: int) -> float' (0 for unseen keys), and a pure function 'core.exploration_rate(exploration: Exploration, step: int) -> float' (or an 'epsilon' property plus a stated step counter). ABL-03 is testable as is.

viz.Replay declares only __init__(game, *, fps), advance() -> int and show(). M1-T20's acceptance and TC-28 need observable state the frozen interface does not expose: (1) the frame currently drawn and the score and step shown with it (TC-28: 'frame i equals Snake.frame() after step i; score and step shown on each frame match the recording'), (2) the current fps, to check that + and - double and halve it, (3) the paused state, to check that space toggles pause, and (4) a public way to deliver a key (space, right, +, -) headless, since AD-07 says tests drive the viewer through its frame-advance function only. The kit's ReplayViewerDouble has fps and index attributes, but the contract does not, so testing them would be guessing. Proposed: add to viz.Replay public attributes fps: float, index: int, paused: bool, a read-only view of the current drawn frame/score/step (e.g. current() -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, float], int]) and on_key(key: str) -> None that the Matplotlib key_press_event handler forwards to. Only the advance-returns sequence (1..11 then 11 x4) is testable today. Also: TC-28 says expected frames come from Snake.frame(), but envs.Snake is not in this task's Read list; the test would compare against the viz.Replay twelve_frames sample's frames instead, which needs confirming.

TC-14 and ABL-01 are untestable via the frozen DQNAgent interface: it exposes only act/learn/save/load, with no online/target network attributes, no update counter, no checkpoint key layout, and no way to see which transitions an update sampled. Please declare inspection points (e.g. online and target torch modules, an updates counter, last sampled batch indices). Also reconcile names: TC-14/plan say use_target/use_memory but the signature has ablation=no_target/no_memory; and the TC-14 corridor_transitions generator and Corridor are not declared in this packet.

M1-T29 acceptance needs two symbols no frozen interface declares: (1) the AD-03 one-learner gymnasium adapter over Snake(view='compact'), which TC-17 runs check_env on and whose observation/action spaces it asserts; (2) the one-to-one settings mapping in src/rllab/reference/train/mapping.py (RunSettings/AgentParams/Exploration -> SB3 DQN kwargs: learning_rate, gamma, batch_size, buffer_size, target_update_interval, learning_starts, policy_kwargs net_arch, train_freq=1, gradient_steps=1, exploration_fraction=decay_steps/steps, exploration_initial/final_eps, max_grad_norm=10, Huber loss, device='cpu'). There is no tests/contracts/ folder or signature for either; only reference.train_reference is frozen, and its RunRecord output does not expose the mapped hyperparameters or the adapter. Please freeze e.g. reference.make_adapter(env) -> gymnasium.Env and reference.dqn_kwargs(settings: RunSettings) -> Mapping[str, object] (with samples) so the tester can write TC-17 and the mapping tests against them.

M1-T32 cannot freeze reference.make_adapter and reference.dqn_kwargs without breaking the frozen contract tests it may not edit. tests/contracts/test_samples.py::test_every_contract_folder_is_known asserts the folders on disk equal its FOLDERS list, which has neither reference.make_adapter nor reference.dqn_kwargs, so creating either folder fails it; and tests/contracts/test_interface.py EXPORTS pins rllab.reference.__all__ to {ReferencePlayer, train_reference}, so exporting make_adapter and dqn_kwargs fails test_component_exports_exactly_its_contract. Both files sit directly in tests/contracts/ at the base, so check.sh treats them as frozen and they are outside this task's Writes. The Revise needs to add the two folders to FOLDERS (with a fake or the right category in test_samples.py), add make_adapter and dqn_kwargs to EXPORTS['reference'], and their SIGNATURES rows ('env, *, team=agents, others=None' and 'settings') in test_interface.py, or put those files in M1-T32's Writes.
